description: Aider-polyglot style (TypeScript): implement semver range matching from a stub and a long instructions file - caret and tilde with the zero rules, x-ranges, hyphen ranges with partial ends, comparators with partial versions, || sets, whitespace after operators, build metadata, prerelease precedence, and the per-set rule that a prerelease only matches a set holding a prerelease comparator on the same version tuple. About 130 table-driven cases make the edge cases the acceptance bar; the post-turn verifier runs them, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
